abilities.name: leaf-guard
abilities.effect: Protects against major status ailments during strong sunlight.

abilities.name: regenerator
abilities.effect: Heals for 1/3 max HP upon switching out.

kanto.flavorText: The whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to seaweed. The vines sway as it walks.

original-johto.flavorText: During battle, it constantly moves the vines that cover its body in order to annoy its opponent.

hoenn.flavorText: Its vines snap off easily and painlessly if they are grabbed, allowing it to make a quick getaway. The lost vines are replaced by new growth the very next day.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It is shrouded by blue vines. No one has seen the face hidden behind this growth of vines.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: The blue vines shrouding its body are covered in a growth of fine hair. It is known to be ticklish.

updated-johto.flavorText: It tangles any moving thing with its vines. Their subtle shaking is ticklish if you get ensnared.

original-unova.flavorText: The blue vines shrouding its body are covered in a growth of fine hair. It is known to be ticklish.

updated-unova.flavorText: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

kalos.flavorText: It tangles any moving thing with its vines. Their subtle shaking is ticklish if you get ensnared.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Tangela’s vines snap off easily if they are grabbed. This happens without pain, allowing it to make a quick getaway. The lost vines are replaced by newly grown vines the very next day.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: Its identity is obscured by masses of thick blue vines. The vines are said to never stop growing.

swsh.flavorText: The vines of a Tangela have a distinct scent. In some parts of Galar, Tangela vines are used as herbs.

freeTextEntries: Grand Underground - Swampy Cave, Bogsunk Cavern (After obtaining the National Pokédex)

pla.flavorText: It is cloaked entirely in blue vines, preventing any glimpse of its true identity. The vines impart a refreshing sensation when chewed—they're useful as a spice.

freeTextEntries: Crimson Mirelands: Gapejaw Bog and nearby, near Cottonsedge Prairie, massive mass outbreaks | Cobalt Coastlands: near Crossing Slope
